name: Hilda Singeh
context: Children’s book author Hilda Singeh shares her experience of Amazon KDP publishing support.
transcript: Hi, everyone. My name is Hilda, and I wanted to share my experience working with Tella, AbdulQudus. I have written three children's books, and I needed someone to help me publish it on Amazon KDP.

So, I went on Fiverr, and I was looking for someone to help me publish my books. And I wasn't sure how to get them done professionally. So, to be able to format it in a professional way, I found him online.
And when I found him, he did an amazing job. So from the beginning, he had paid attention to details. He professionally, he was professional, and he did an incredible job.

He was very knowledgeable in what he was doing, and he carefully edited all the manuscripts and everything that is needed for the book. So, the book was beautifully formatted, and it actually makes Amazon standard, Amazon KDP standard. So, the final book, all the three books, they look amazing, and the entire publishing process was much smoother than I expected.

So, my books are now published on Amazon, and I'm very happy that my work has been published, and my dream has come to pass. What I really appreciated working with him was his attention to details. I also enjoy the fact that he clearly communicated with me from every step, and he was willing to answer every question that I have.

Throughout the entire project, he generally really cared about delivering good quality work, and I would recommend him to anybody who wants to edit, format, or publish his or her book in a professional way. I highly recommend him because I'm very happy with his work, and my friends who read my book and ordered it on Amazon have been very happy with his work. So, thank you so much, Tella, for your hard work and dedication.
Thank you for your attention to details, and again, I would recommend him to anybody who wants to publish his or her book. Thank you so much.
